save_model_torch_model: save a torch nn.Module to a safetensors file on disk, handling shared tensor memory automatically
load_model_onto_torch_module: load a safetensors file onto a torch nn.Module with strict or lenient key matching on a specified device
save_tensors_to_bytes: save a dictionary of contiguous torch tensors into raw bytes in safetensors format
save_tensors_to_file: save a dictionary of contiguous torch tensors into a safetensors file on disk with optional metadata
load_tensors_from_file: load a safetensors file into a dictionary of torch tensors on a specified device
